name: JV_DISTRIBUTABLE_VALUES_
description: This table contains values for each segment that represent accounts that are distributable. Only segments that are flagged as distributable in jv_joint_ventures_b will be allowed to have values.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTABLE_VALUES_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the segment values.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: COST_CENTER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a primary segment value associated with the joint venture.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTABLE_GROUP_NUM
columns.description: A number used to identify a group of distributable segment values for the primary segment value.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture.
